klt_source: throwaway uvx env, uvx --with klayout --from klayout-tools==0.9.1 klt lvs --format json (one single local run, about 5 min; klayout engine 0.30.13, which the report flags as a mismatch against the 0.30.12 this klt build was tested against)
summary: First compare against the stream re-routed with the pin-geometry layer-map fix (issue #149). Verdict: mismatch, unchanged in grade. The diagnosed defect is gone: the layout now extracts 268 top-level pins against 266 in the reference (r10/r11: 2), and 266 pin names were anchored by name before comparing (topology.top_level_pins_anchored, r10/r11 anchored none). With an anchor the compare pairs an order of magnitude more: nets matched 352 (r10/r11 34) and devices matched 199 (37). The residual net-level disagreement is only slightly smaller and still dominates: net.split 15331 (was 15761), net.merged 15246 (was 15676), device.unmatched 56195 (was 56563). hints.rejected reappears at 68 because there are now pin hints to reject. The P&R result itself is unchanged (route_drc_violation_count 0, antenna_violation_count 0, clock skew 0.00771 ns, same placement and routing); only the DEF->GDS merge differs.
request_notes: The r11 request verbatim apart from the scratch pdk_root and pin_order_files paths, so the stream is the only variable against r11. pdk_root and pin_order_files point at the pinned lambdapdk v0.2.17 tree (archive sha256 ac7e950c4d0394a829658b6e219fea4a4b0c61a998183d5520f8b9e38c6efff2), re-fetched into /tmp scratch, not committed.
upstream: 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5700 (linked from spec/asap7-bringup.md): klt place-and-route writes the top-level DEF PINS rectangle and its name label to the layer map's pin purpose, which the extraction decks read as a label layer only, so klt lvs extracts a top-level pin only where routing metal on the drawing layer happens to coincide with the pin label. The workaround recorded here is layout-side; the inconsistency between the two verbs survives it.
not_done: The netlist, deck and compare options were not edited to force a match; no option was waived (power_connectivity and supply_nets untouched, per decision 0005). The residual net.split / net.merged disagreement was not traced; that is still the open step. DRC was not re-run over the added M4 pin geometry (#64, #66 out of scope). layout/lane_column.gds is not carried forward unchanged: it was re-assembled over this stream in the same commit, so assemble_column.py --check exits 0 here.
power_connectivity_reason: reference.form is 'gate-level-verilog' on a FinFET layout.deck, so supply connectivity takes part in the ordinary compare and the stub-form power-pin check does not apply. Same reason r10/r11 record; not a waiver.
